images.alt: An engine on a workbench held in an adjustable metal frame with a large dial gauge above it; some of the frame's bolts are loosened and a wrench rests on the bench beside it.
images.prompt: A single engine block sits on a workbench inside a frame of adjustable metal arms that hold a large round dial gauge above it. Several arms are visibly mid-adjustment: loosened bolts, one arm swung out of position, a wrench resting on the bench. The gauge needle sits high in its range. The engine itself is untouched and central, well clear of the edges.

images.alt: Two identical engines in different metal frames on a workbench, each with a dial gauge showing a different reading.
images.prompt: Two identical engine blocks side by side on a workbench, each bolted into a differently shaped metal frame with a large round dial gauge mounted on it. The two needles point to clearly different positions. Both engines are plainly the same object, centred with space around them.

images.alt: Ten gauges beneath a target line, a mechanical arm adjusting one, and a single fenced-off gauge standing apart.
images.prompt: Ten identical pressure gauges in a row on a laboratory wall, each needle below one target line drawn across all of them. A small mechanical arm on a rail reaches toward one gauge with a wrench. One more gauge stands apart on the right behind a low rope barrier.

images.alt: Two workbenches with identical tools, one organised on a labelled pegboard with notes, the other piled in a heap.
images.prompt: Two long workbenches seen from above, each holding the same set of hand tools. On the upper bench the tools hang on a labelled pegboard with a short handwritten card beside each. On the lower bench the identical tools lie in an unsorted heap. Both benches sit well inside the frame.
